title: Vision Arabic and mixed-direction OCR reliability
goal: Measure Arabic OCR and preservation of mixed RTL/LTR identifiers.
prompt: Use vision.analyze with mode ocr, detail high, and output detailed. Preserve Arabic text and the exact LTR tokens EC-2048, USD 73.45, and PAID.
prerequisites: Configure a vision-capable route and explicit provider credentials.
Review hosted image processing, budget, and approval settings before enabling this opt-in task.
steps: Run the prompt against the mixed-direction fixture.
Compare logical text order and technical tokens with manifest.json.
Record rendering defects separately from OCR-content defects.
assertions: Arabic words remain readable in logical order.
EC-2048, USD 73.45, and PAID are copied exactly.
The model does not translate or reorder technical tokens.
notes: Accuracy percent uses the five expected manifest items.
Inspect both semantic OCR accuracy and displayed bidirectional order.
